commands: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== ESP-IDF 5.5.1 ENV SETUP ==='; IDF="$HOME/esp/esp-idf"; test "$(git -C "$IDF" describe --tags --always --dirty)" = 'v5.5.1'; "$IDF/install.sh" esp32s3; source "$IDF/export.sh"; command -v idf.py; idf.py --version; test "$(idf.py --version)" = 'ESP-IDF v5.5.1'; echo 'IDF_ENV_READY'

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== WEB GATE ==='; test "$(pnpm --version)" = '11.10.0'; pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm --dir web typecheck; pnpm --dir web lint; pnpm --dir web test; pnpm --dir web build; echo 'WEB_GATE_OK'
set -euo pipefail; echo '=== ESP-IDF BUILD GATE ==='; source "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh"; bash scripts/idf_gate_build.sh; echo 'ESP_IDF_BUILD_GATE_OK'
set -euo pipefail; echo '=== FINAL WORKTREE CHECK ==='; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; git status --short; echo 'LOCAL_TOOLCHAIN_ENABLE_OK'
